blind.observation: Across all eight anonymous boards and eight fixed cameras per case, A and B were visually coincident; no rail, optic, ADS-axis, intersection, float, material, completeness, duplication, or framing mismatch was discernible.

sources.conclusion: The IW3 loader converts hideTags and enforces the fixed array extent.
IW3 has capacity for eight hide tags.
Info-string arrays accept LF and CR separators.
The IW3 writer emits literal LF between hide-tag entries.
OAT derives XSurface partBits from referenced surface bones.
CoD4 hidepart submits the DObj hide mask.
CoD4 rendering intersects four surface part-bit words with the hide mask.

sourceSemantics.conclusion: Literal LF is valid IW3 hideTags grammar with an eight-name limit. OAT maps actual bone membership into surface partBits; CoD4 hides a surface when those bits intersect the DObj hide mask.

poolProjection.method: Enumerated all nonempty model references in all 95 exact-checkpoint weapon overrides; applied only the eight staged field sets in memory; excluded unchanged protected gunModel2/worldModel2 symmetrically from the target-weapon changed-slot domain; and diffed unique names.
poolProjection.qualification: This is the mandated primary-slot substitution projection. Protected finish-slot bindings are reported separately. It is not a rebuilt integrated package or a measured runtime-pool result.

packageFingerprints.qualification: The historical package binaries are not present in the recovery tree. Their exact fingerprints are therefore verified as frozen status-record values, not by re-hashing absent files.
